name: Tyrion Cuthbert: Beyond the Arcane
source:
In the wake of the events of [url=/v45489]Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane[/url], Beyond the Arcane, throws players into a global conspiracy entwined with the late mother of protagonist Tyrion Cuthbert and the formidable Theocracy of Lumina. Tyrion's quest for answers about his mother's past and the sudden interest in his own burgeoning powers will take him on a world-spanning investigation far beyond the isolated kingdom of Wyverngarde.

The murder trials this time will be overseen by the Ordo Astralis, an international peacekeeping organization, and will introduce a formidable new prosecutor: High Inquisitor Illia Stormwake of the Theocracy of Lumina. While often appearing carefree, Stormwake is a ruthless pursuer of victory in the courtroom.

Due to plot developments in the prequel, Tyrion's former companion, [url=/c127689]Celeste McCoy[/url], will be unable to join him in his investigations. In her place, he will be accompanied by the [url=/c127719]Miriam Frega[/url], who will also serve as Tyrion's mode of transport across the various nations.
translation:
事件发生后[url=/v45489]提利昂·库斯伯特：奥术律师[/url]《超越奥术》将玩家带入一场与主角提利昂·库斯伯特已故母亲和强大的卢米纳神权政治纠缠在一起的全球阴谋。提利昂寻求有关他母亲过去的答案，以及对自己不断发展的力量突然产生的兴趣，这将使他展开一场跨越世界的调查，远远超出孤立的维文加德王国。

这次的谋杀案审判将由国际维和组织阿斯特里斯审判庭监督，并将引入一位令人敬畏的新检察官：卢米纳教国的高级调查官伊莉亚·斯托克威。虽然暴风经常显得无忧无虑，但她在法庭上却是一个无情的胜利者。

由于前传的剧情发展，提利昂的前同伴，[url=/c127689]塞莱斯特·麦考伊[/url]，将无法加入他的调查。代替她，他将由[url=/c127719]米里亚姆·弗雷加[/url]，他也将作为提利昂穿越各国的交通工具。
